facts.fact: The Agenda's sectoral indicators give the share of the population holding a shared medical record (DMP, dossier médical partagé) as 0% in 2021, attributed to the Ministry of Health, against a 2025 target of 50%; it gives no numerator or denominator and names no tier.

The Agenda National de Transformation Numérique 2022-2025, issued by the digital transformation ministry in June 2022, sets a target of 50% of the population holding a shared medical record (DMP) by 2025, alongside a costed eSanté project (EUR 7 million, 36 months) and a digital health master plan (EUR 300,000, 12 months); the sectoral axis is budgeted 89% from partners and 11% from the State.
